Blink Marketing is a real estate marketing membership built by agents. Starting at $29/month billed yearly ($49 month-to-month), you get pre-made Canva templates for social media, email newsletters, postcards, and pop-bys. There is no video editing and no advertised client dashboard; only the custom plans add a mockup approval step.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
Here is how they compare across every category that matters.

VEXI edits your videos for you.

Blink offers no free trial. You pay before using the portal, though free sample posts and a sample newsletter are available.

A template membership for agents who want print and social media resources in one place. The Canva templates and postcards are useful. But content comes from a shared library unless you pay for custom, auto-posting only covers Facebook and Instagram, and there is no video editing.
Built for people who want it done right.
Is Blink Marketing a done-for-you service?

Only partially. Blink’s Level 1 plan is entirely DIY — you get templates and post everything yourself. Levels 2 and 3 add auto-posting to Facebook and Instagram only (5x per week); standard posts come from a shared library, and the custom versions ($299–$399/mo) add your logo, colors and headshot.
Does Blink Marketing include video editing?
No. Blink provides video scripts and Reel templates, but no video production or editing service. You film and edit everything yourself.
Which platforms does Blink Marketing post to?
Blink’s auto-posting feature (Levels 2 and 3 only) covers Facebook and Instagram. There is no posting to LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, or X.
Does Blink Marketing have a client dashboard?

No. Blink does not advertise a client dashboard or visual content calendar; only custom plans include a mockup approval step. You log in to the portal for templates and resources; custom plans send a mockup for approval before posting.
